meta.name: sql-workflow
meta.description: Use this skill before writing any SQL query. Covers: output shape inference (cardinality clues from the question), efficient schema exploration, iterative CTE-based query building, structured verification loop (row count, NULL audit, fan-out check, sample inspection), error recovery protocol, saving output to result.sql and result.csv, turn budget management, and common benchmark traps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 写 SQL 查询前，Claude 会先探索数据库结构，推断查询输出行数，然后逐步构建并验证查询，最后将 SQL 和结果保存为文件。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 写一个 SQL 查询时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 SQL 查询，统计每个用户的订单总额。
say.note: Claude 会按流程探索、构建并验证查询。

say.text: 写一个 SQL 查询，找出销售额前 10 的产品。
say.note: Claude 会限制结果行数并检查扇出。

say.text: 写一个 SQL 查询，计算每个月的平均订单金额。
say.note: Claude 会推断输出形状并分组聚合。

howto.what_en: Before writing any SQL query, Claude will explore the database schema, infer output row count from the question, build the query iteratively with CTEs, verify results step by step, and finally save the SQL and CSV files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write a SQL query.

say_en.text: Write a SQL query to count the total orders per user.
say_en.note: Claude will explore, build, and verify the query.

say_en.text: Write a SQL query to find the top 10 products by sales.
say_en.note: Claude will limit rows and check for fan-out.

say_en.text: Write a SQL query to calculate the average order amount per month.
say_en.note: Claude will infer output shape and group by month.
